items.description: Resolve or explicitly accept the 18 documented historical failures before final release approval: 2 CLI version assertions, 9 registry git-subprocess assertions, 6 public/release audit assertions and 1 controlled-vocabulary assertion.
Reconcile historical tests and release metadata that still distinguish 0.2.5a0 from the current 0.2.6a0 candidate.
Review pre-closeout G07 documents and other historical records that retain earlier NOT_STARTED or candidate wording; preserve history and do not rewrite evidence without a controlled reason.
Reconcile the controlled public-document audit count and workstation-dependent audit findings during the release sweep.
Review remaining PRESENT_REQUALIFICATION_PENDING labels for consistency with closed bounded gates without changing Owner maturity decisions.
Run the final release sweep and complete the independent Owner release review at G15. This G14 audit is not a publication approval.
Review historical LAST_VERIFIED_SHA and release SHA entries, confirm each is intentionally historical, and ensure none is used as current qualification evidence without its declared provenance.
Inventory any dead or stale tests, routes or generated artifacts found during the release sweep; remove or retire them only with explicit evidence and historical continuity.
Re-run or explicitly accept stateful Owner-review and workstation-dependent audit findings in the final release environment; retain environment limitations when they cannot be reproduced.
